title: Evaluate CAD/BIM engine candidates
objective: Determine whether the current CAD/BIM candidate foundation (IfcOpenShell + IFC/openBIM stack, OpenCascade Technology as geometry kernel, FreeCAD, additional candidates only where a material gap is evidenced) can satisfy ConstructionOS feasibility requirements without changing the frozen adapter architecture. Deliverable: a reproducible evidence package — not production CAD.
acceptance_criteria: Each required capability has observed evidence, not feature-list claims.
Results distinguish native capability, adapter capability, and missing capability.
IFC semantic fidelity is tested, not inferred from successful file opening.
Licensing/composition analysis names the exact components and licenses tested.
Recommendation is one of: (a) proceed with candidate behind adapter; (b) reject candidate and evaluate next; (c) reduce scope without architecture change; (d) Architecture Change Request required.
non_goals: No silent replacement of the Construction Graph with an engine-native model.
No threshold-setting (RESEARCH-CAD-006) and no composition approval (LICENSE-001).
risk_assumptions: DEPENDENCY-GATE FLAG: ARCH-WF-001 is MERGED (merge commit c0a722a, governance CI run 32776682467 green) but not yet VERIFIED; verification is the Architect's pending post-merge decision (requested in PR #14). The validator's dependency invariant therefore reports one failing check for this record until that decision lands. The Architect declared this work item eligible (Issue #1, 2026-08-24T19:42:57Z) and the Product Owner directed execution (Issue #1, 2026-08-24T20:56:01Z). The invariant is NOT weakened silently; resolution path: Architect records ARCH-WF-001 VERIFIED, then this validation turns green.
FreeCAD could not be installed in the benchmark sandbox (no sudo/apt; conda-forge CDN unreachable) — Sketcher/Draft/TechDraw untested, recorded as unknown, not as engine failure; follow-up required.
Performance numbers are single-environment observations, not thresholds.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic benchmark suite covering the ten required evidence areas (2D drafting, 3D geometry, parametrics, BIM semantics, IFC round-trip, quantities, performance, Construction Graph mapping, adapter/replacement, licensing inventory).
Reproducible fixtures: 2D plan, small architectural BIM model, openings/quantities model, IFC round-trip fixture, medium performance model.
Committed evidence run with environment snapshot, per-benchmark results and summary.
Findings report distinguishing measured results from inferred conclusions, with explicit failures and limitations.

transitions.reason: Architect status comment on Issue #1: RESEARCH-CAD-001 is the first eligible substantive work item; Architecture v1.0 remains frozen; work must not be marked VERIFIED based on feature lists, screenshots, successful file opens or narrative claims.

Execution directive on Issue #1: implement the reproducible CAD/BIM candidate benchmark described in the issue; do not build production CAD or change Architecture v1.0; submit a focused PR with fixtures, benchmark scripts, exact versions, quantitative results, failure modes, licensing/composition evidence and reproducibility commands.

Implementation started on branch work/research-cad-001-benchmark: benchmark harness with epistemic labeling, deterministic fixtures, CAD/BIM adapter contract with IfcOpenShell+OCCT and pure-Python reference implementations, eleven benchmark modules, CI workflow and findings report.
